what: Validation gate: Kimi-Audio zero-shot p_yes on the first 10 original Pitt windows (canonical file order) vs the canonical paper file, tolerance 1e-3
determinism: same clip scored twice in one process and again in a separate process: identical to the last printed digit (diag.log, val10 vs orig468 max diff 0.0)
hidden_state_check: audio-span mean of each LM layer vs overnight2/kimi/kimi_pitt_states.npz: relative error 0.3-0.5% at layer 0, rising to 1.6-3.0% at layer 27 (cosine 0.99999 at layer 0, 0.9996-0.9999 at layer 27). Most consistent with numeric drift across hardware/kernels growing with depth; the canonical run saved no discrete audio token ids, so token-level identity of the input cannot be checked.
